policy: Each entry in this allowlist must match a `// allowed-skip: <id>` annotation in the Flutter test files. The skip checker fails the build when the count exceeds the budget, when an entry drifts from its anchor, or when a marker is unapproved. New skips require a new entry; removed skips require removing the matching entry.

skips.reason: version string is rendered on the system status screen, not the home surface; the assertions need to be re-pointed at the new home layout in a follow-up change
The home surface does not surface a system-info retry control; the new wire-level tests in api_client_request_test.dart cover the offline-to-retry contract
The SignInScreen has migrated to per-field errorText; the existing per-field assertions cover the new copy in tests further down this file
"My profile" lives on the anonymous home surface; tapping it from a signed-in shell route is not wired up in the current nav. Re-target this test once the workspace nav exposes the profile entry
Registration screen now uses per-field errorText; covered by the inline errorText test further down this file
Registration routes through the new dedicated RegistrationConfirmationScreen; the confirmation copy is asserted in the onboarding_test.dart suite
SignInScreen now surfaces the server error inline; the inline errorText test in this file covers the same path
